page.layout: One page of text; marginal notes in the left margin (four short notes beside the first paragraph); running head and page number at the top; a woodcut ornament below the text; a signature "L I." at the lower right; a digitiser's line at the bottom right (not transcribed).

main_text.l: XVII. Eo igitur magis nobis annitendum, ne simplicem cultus no-
stri paraturam simili adulterio polluamus: necum illorum ritibus, ad
omnia mala ducentibus, communionem habeamus: ne illos praeter ver-
bum multiplicemus, & ex indifferentibus faciamus necessarios, cum ser-
vitute & opinione justitiae, aut cultus, & cum subjectione: neve per ri-
tus, quos male quidam vocant indifferentes, Ecclesiae nostrae & verita-
tis hostibus assimilemur, iisque conciliemur. Quibus scopulis evitatis,
circa ritus externos indifferentes non adeo morosum esse decet, neque
propter diversum eorum usum nemo condemnandus aut aversandus
est. Cum nihil repugnet, sub diversis ritibus eandem latitare fidem;
imo illa ipsa varietas rituum libertati Christianae demonstrandae ac co-
nservandae egregie conducat: ut hoc nomine, si non laudanda, certe

marginalia.note: Cujus puritati & simplicitati ideo eo magis studendum.

page.notes: Marginal note text is printed in small italic and is partly cut off; read as "Cujus puritati & simplicitati ideo eo magis studendum" across four lines. Some letters of the notes are doubtful. The ornament below the text is a woodcut and is not transcribed. The digitiser's watermark at the bottom right is omitted.
